props.name: color
props.description: Color of the lit segments; any CSS color.

props.name: time
props.description: A fixed time to show instead of the running clock.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA time zone, like "Europe/London"; the viewer's own when unset.

props.name: leadingZero
props.description: "09:05" instead of " 9:05". Defaults on for 24-hour time.

props.name: showPeriod
props.description: A small AM/PM indicator, for 12-hour time.

props.name: blink
props.description: Blink the colon with the seconds.

props.name: ghost
props.description: Show unlit segments faintly, like a real LED face.

props.name: framed
props.description: Put the digits in a plastic housing with a glass face. Off by default: just the display.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; defaults to the time shown.

examples.title: world clocks
examples.setup:
const zones = [
  { city: "New York", zone: "America/New_York" },
  { city: "London", zone: "Europe/London" },
  { city: "Tokyo", zone: "Asia/Tokyo" },
]
examples.code:
{zones.map(({ city, zone }) => (
{city}
))}
